name: The bar
about: A dim bar where your skills talk about tonight's work. A jukebox, a bartender, a neon sign.
gags: regular
A regular at the end of the bar has highlighted his whole textbook yellow. He says it's all important.
regular
Someone scratched O(n²) into the counter. Underneath, smaller: "but n is small".
bartender
polishes a glass that's already clean. Like rereading a problem you already solved.
regular
A coaster reads: SLEEP IS PART OF THE SYLLABUS.
jukebox
The jukebox plays one song on loop. Nobody has ever complained.
regular
A man in the corner has been on chapter one since spring. He says this time he's really starting.
bartender
Behind the bar hangs a framed library fine, paid in full, eleven years late.
regular
Someone left a napkin covered in flashcards. The hard one is circled three times.
regular
House rule by the door: no new topics after midnight. Ignored nightly.
bartender
says the secret ingredient is a good night's sleep. He says that about everything.
jukebox
The neon sign buzzes in B-flat. Everyone in here is in B-flat.
regular
Two regulars argue about tabs versus spaces. The bartender serves them both water.
regular
A patron asks if you've tried turning it off and on again. You have. It was a cache problem.
bartender
keeps a jar labelled DROPPED FACTORS OF TWO. It's nearly full.

lines.day: Another cap for the jar. The bartender doesn't say anything. He doesn't have to.
lines.week: A week won. A new sign goes up behind the bar.
lines.die: A die, finished. It goes in the case with the others.
lines.gift: The bartender slid something across the counter. It's on your shelf.
